### 

Welcome! This is a space where I share my thoughts, learnings, and ideas related to statistics, ecotoxicology, and more. Think of it as a dump or a jungle of information — while it may seem chaotic and unorganized, there could be hidden gems of insight and knowledge within.:) The primary goal of this site is to help myself understand and learn more effectively while keeping a log of my thought process. Although the content may not be perfectly organized, I hope part of it can serve as a valuable resource for others who have similar questions and interests in these fields. Here, you will find a collection of reflections, analyses, and discussions that I hope will inspire and assist fellow professionals and learners.
